name: Archetype
description: Free and open-source (MIT) guided D&D 5e character builder and digital sheet — multilingual (EN/ES/PT), auto-calculated rules engine, Next.js 16 + Turso

paragraphs: Archetype is a guided character builder and digital sheet for Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition. It walks you through character creation in nine steps, calculates every number for you, and keeps your sheets ready for the table — in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

saves, attacks, spell slots, and spellcasting DC are computed at render time by a pure, tested rules engine (src/domain/calc.ts, 144 unit checks). Change a level, race, or score and everything recalculates instantly.
features: Beginner-friendly by design — a step-by-step wizard with inline warnings explains what each
Every value derived, nothing hard-coded — ability modifiers, proficiency bonus, AC, HP,
Transparent formulas — each derived value shows its own breakdown
SRD content included — 14 classes (including Artificer and Blood Hunter), 127 subclasses,
Nine guided steps: Identity → Abilities → Features → Skills → Equipment →
